title: Invention of Air Conditioning
lineage: Passages inspected; retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.note: Company history describes Carrier’s 1902 design at Sackett & Wilhelms, for humidity problems in multicolor printing. It reports a 55% humidity target and well water in 1902, supplemented by ammonia compressor in 1903. Its priority and performance claims are retrospective.
